changes.title: New Unified Dock style
changes.detail: One floating pill: Launcher, apps, tray, Quick Settings, a notification bell and a two-line clock. Settings › Dock & Bar › Dock style. Floating stays the default.

changes.title: Window marks and carousel
changes.detail: A dash means one window and three dots mean two or more. Apps with several windows show a carousel you can scroll, click or arrow through.

changes.title: Smooth reflow and Launcher pins
changes.detail: Pin, unpin, reorder, open and close glide into place. The Launcher marks pinned apps and offers Pin/Unpin on right-click.

changes.title: Dock keys
changes.detail: With an icon focused, use the arrows, Home/End or type a name to find an app. The arrow into the screen opens its window list.

changes.title: Dock fixes
changes.detail: Failed clicks say "Couldn't open …". Admin windows no longer land on the wrong pin. Side-Dock menus stay on screen. Icon size works on every style.

changes.title: New music pop-out
changes.detail: Hover a player in the Dock for artwork, a level meter, a seek bar, bigger controls and a soft sound glow. The glow and meter can be turned off in Settings › Music.

changes.title: Simpler Lens app icons
changes.detail: Thick white symbols on a plain dark tile. Lens Browser keeps the colourful Lens logo.

changes.title: Dock & Bar › Advanced
changes.detail: Magnification, launch animation, app names, scroll-to-switch, icon size per style and more, all in one place.

changes.title: Side-Dock pop-outs
changes.detail: With the Dock on the left or right edge, Settings and Quick Settings open beside it and inside the screen.

changes.title: Back to first theme restores all
changes.detail: Going back to your first theme choice restores folder colours and the Day & night schedule too (B-39 fixed).

changes.title: Themes don't change the Dock
changes.detail: Themes are colours only. CRT merged into Green Phosphor and Claude Light Brand into Claude Light; old choices still work.

changes.title: Readable text in every pack
changes.detail: All 87 packs checked: 18 dark packs got lighter secondary text, and two light accents are darker.

changes.title: Faster theme switching
changes.detail: Theme switches are quicker, with no visual change.

changes.title: Window buttons honour settings
changes.detail: Excluded apps, button style and left/right position now apply to other apps. The left side has only been checked in tests.

changes.title: Per-app window buttons
changes.detail: Settings › Windows & Keys › Window styling has a switch per app. Protected apps show a locked badge.

changes.title: One anti-cheat list everywhere
changes.detail: Every Lens feature uses the same list of protected games, so Alt+drag can no longer move a protected game's window.

changes.title: Multi-monitor fixes
changes.detail: The Dock appears on a second monitor with different scaling (B-62). Settings and Search no longer cover the Dock on small high-scaling screens (B-64).

changes.title: Top Bar auto-hide fix
changes.detail: After a start-up hiccup, an auto-hidden Top Bar no longer stays drawn (B-126). The Launcher closes on a click outside (B-128).

changes.title: Top Bar switches
changes.detail: A single on/off switch controls the Top Bar. New Pointer halo switch; the halo also goes away when Windows transparency is off.

changes.title: No stuck pop-outs
changes.detail: Menus close after lock/unlock and focus changes. After an Explorer restart the Dock still shows apps flashing for attention (B-65).

changes.title: Magic button (off by default)
changes.detail: A Windows-key tap opens Lens Magic Start: search, pins, Magic actions, recents, Lock. Ctrl+Esc always opens Windows Start.

changes.title: Magic Mouse (off by default)
changes.detail: An animated Lens pointer. Hold, then drag, to grab part of the screen into Snip; hold to open Magic. Your pointers come back when it's off.

changes.title: Desktop widgets (off by default)
changes.detail: Widgets on the desktop, below your windows: clock, today, notes, now playing, battery, weather. Add, resize and move them in edit mode.

changes.title: Magic Dashboard (off by default)
changes.detail: A side panel with Inbox, Feeds, Today, Shelf, Now playing, an approved-sources Widgets lane and an X lane.

changes.title: Selection bar + Magic Search
changes.detail: Off by default. Select text in almost any app for Cut, Copy, Paste, Magic Search and your actions. Magic Search answers with web and local results.

changes.title: Approvals tied to the exact step
changes.detail: An OK only works for the action it was shown for. If a page changes after you approved, Lens asks again.

changes.title: Plan view
changes.detail: When Lens proposes several steps at once, you see the whole plan and can Allow or Deny each step.

changes.title: Undo survives restart
changes.detail: Command's undo history (last 50 steps) is kept across restarts.

changes.title: Teach me and examples
changes.detail: After Command changes a setting, it says where the setting lives, with Show me. There are example commands under the empty Do field.

changes.title: Magic window and Shelf fixes
changes.detail: Snip this window and Open in Lens Browser now show (B-70). The Shelf has Undo and Menu-key menus. Shelf to Notes is off by default.

changes.title: Voice conversation stays light
changes.detail: Interrupting no longer leaves listeners behind, and the hidden window stays idle (B-120).

changes.title: Reader view
changes.detail: The toolbar's Reader button shows the page's text cleanly; size, width and font are remembered.

changes.title: Clearer browser errors
changes.detail: Failed browser actions show a message. An unanswered permission request says so after 60 s.

changes.title: Messenger badges
changes.detail: Unread counts from Slack, Discord and other web messengers in Lens Browser reach the Messages badge.

changes.title: Live text
changes.detail: In the Snip studio press L to select words on the image, then Copy, Highlight or Hide them. Links, emails and codes get one-press copy.

changes.title: New Snip shortcut
changes.detail: The default is now Ctrl+Alt+X (it clashed with Save As). A shortcut you chose yourself is kept.

changes.title: Crop, keys and history fixes
changes.detail: Cropped-out text stays out of Copy text, previews aren't stretched after a crop, Enter only runs the focused button, and history has Undo.

changes.title: Weighted presses
changes.detail: On for everyone: controls sink briefly and spring back; Quick Settings and Search grow from the Top Bar button. Instant with reduced motion.

changes.title: Switches keep focus
changes.detail: Switches no longer vanish or lose focus after a click (B-40). Hot corners can be set up while off (B-41).

changes.title: Pop-out close delay
changes.detail: Short, Normal or Long in Dock & Bar › Advanced › Close after.

changes.title: Tidier sidebar
changes.detail: One Notifications page under Focus & Notifications. "Apps" is now "Lens Apps".

changes.title: Safety net card
changes.detail: About & Testing lists what Lens touches and never touches. The Updates card says when updates aren't available yet.

changes.title: Lens Music Immersive
changes.detail: Settings › Music (off by default): full-screen Immersive (F11), artwork colours, per-song lyric timing, opt-in translation and Discord status.

changes.title: Music Equalizer and Remote
changes.detail: Switches Equalizer APO presets if it's installed. Lens Remote (phone control) is Tester mode only.

changes.title: Lens Apps Library
changes.detail: See what you have and what's new, and run Update all with one approval. Every app page has credits and licence notes.

changes.title: Alarms and reminders
changes.detail: Alarms are right after a time-zone or DST change and say when they're late after sleep. Remind me on a Notes to-do sets a Timer.

changes.title: Cleaner delete code
changes.detail: Permanent delete needs a typed 4-digit code, then a hold. Spotify sign-in works when port 43117 is busy.

changes.title: More errors shown
changes.detail: Many swallowed errors in the Dock, Settings, Lens Apps, Snip and Shelf now show a message (B-18 ongoing).

changes.title: Steadier automated tests
changes.detail: Top Bar auto-hide, theme toggle and Control Center checks are deterministic, and the theme-switch speed gate is fairer.

changes.title: Mission Control (dev only)
changes.detail: A developer-only admin window; it is not in tester builds.

test_steps.steps: Click buttons, switches, chips and tabs in Settings, Quick Settings and Search, quickly and held. Repeat with Settings › Accessibility › Animation effects off.
test_steps.expected: Each press sinks and springs back. One click does one thing. Pop-outs grow from the Top Bar button; no movement with reduced motion.

test_steps.steps: Turn on Settings › AI & Command › Selection bar. Select text in Notepad, Word, a browser and VS Code; press Copy, then Magic Search. Try a terminal and a password field.
test_steps.expected: The bar shows below the selection without taking the keyboard. Copy works, Esc hides it. Magic Search names its sources. No bar in terminals or password fields.

test_steps.steps: Settings › Dock & Bar › Top Bar › Auto-hide: Always hide. Restart Lens and don't touch the top edge for 10 s. Then open the Launcher and click the desktop.
test_steps.expected: The bar hides and stays hidden until the pointer reaches the top. The Launcher closes on the outside click.

test_steps.steps: Two monitors at 100 % and 150 %: choose the second in Settings › Dock & Bar › Monitor, then Follow the pointer. Try a monitor left of/above the main one; unplug and replug.
test_steps.expected: The Dock appears on the chosen monitor at the right size and reveals from auto-hide. Settings and Quick Settings open beside it, on screen.

test_steps.steps: Tester mode on, then About & Testing › Magic (preview) › Magic button on. Tap Win twice; press Esc right after opening; try Ctrl+Esc, Win+L, Win+D. Turn it off.
test_steps.expected: A tap opens Magic Start; a second tap or Esc closes it. Ctrl+Esc opens Windows Start and Win+keys work. Off gives the key back to Windows.

test_steps.steps: Turn on Settings › Music › Music and play a track. Open Immersive (F11 or the Dock music card). With Equalizer APO installed, pick a preset, then Off, then Remove all Lens changes.
test_steps.expected: Immersive fills the monitor under the pointer; Esc/F11/× close it. The EQ preset applies; Off and Remove all remove only Lens's line and keep your own config.txt edits.

test_steps.steps: Magic (preview) › Magic Mouse on (confirm). Hold ~0.5 s and drag; hold without moving; normal clicks and drags in Explorer and a browser. Turn it off.
test_steps.expected: The Lens pointer shows. Hold-drag opens Snip and hold opens Magic. Normal clicks are unchanged. Off restores your exact previous pointers.

test_steps.steps: Settings › Dock & Bar › Dock style › Unified. Open 3 Notepad windows and hover Notepad; use the wheel, ‹ › and arrows. Pin, unpin and reorder an app.
test_steps.expected: One pill with Launcher, apps, tray, bell and clock, not full width. The carousel shows the right live picture, no stale thumbnails. Icons glide.

test_steps.steps: Magic (preview) › Desktop widgets on, then Arrange desktop widgets. Add Clock, Today and Batteries; resize to Large; move; Done. Press Win+D; open a fullscreen game.
test_steps.expected: Widgets stay below windows and never take focus. Clicks between widgets reach desktop icons. They hide under fullscreen apps.

test_steps.steps: Turn on Settings › AI & Command › Lens Snip. Ctrl+Alt+X, snip a web page, press L, drag across two lines, Copy; Hide a sentence; crop out an email, then Copy text.
test_steps.expected: The selection sits on the words at 100/150/200 %. Copy gives exactly those words. Hidden words copy as •••. The cropped email isn't copied.

test_steps.steps: Alt+Space, then Tab to a Dock icon. Use the arrows, type "sp", and press the arrow into the screen on a running app. Run Task Manager as administrator.
test_steps.expected: Focus moves along the Dock and the match is ringed. The window list opens and Enter switches. The admin window gets its own icon.

test_steps.steps: In Cleaner, start a permanent delete of a test file, type a wrong code three times, then close without confirming.
test_steps.expected: Nothing is deleted without the correct 4-digit code and a hold.

known_issues: Selection bar: the first selection after start-up (or in a new app) sometimes shows no bar (B-129); the fix is in open PR #144.
Selection bar not finished: drag-to-reorder actions, the per-app editor and the closing animation. Mixed-scaling placement is unchecked on a real PC.
Magic Mouse: the fixed hold-drag automated test has not re-run in CI; 100–200 % scaling and monitors left of/above the main one are unchecked.
Desktop widgets only show on Lens's monitor. Bluetooth batteries, screen time and photos aren't built, and widgets show no remote images.
Lens Remote (Tester mode only) uses plain HTTP on your home network; use it only on a trusted network and allow Private networks only.
Equalizer needs Equalizer APO installed. Windows Sonic can't be switched by apps, so that row opens Sound settings.
Window buttons on the left may cover the app icon and title on classic title bars; this has only been checked in tests.
No hotkey focuses the Dock yet; use Alt+Space then Tab, a click, or Alt+1–9.
Extra Top Bars on other monitors don't auto-hide or click through yet. Pinned folders are not drawn on the Dock.
Cleaner doesn't review a Downloads folder that has been moved, for example into OneDrive.
No signed release is published yet, so the Updates card offers no Check now.
One-click transcription setup is blocked until download hashes are pinned (B-07).
A renderer crash during start-up can freeze Lens for up to a minute (B-31b); seen only in automated tests.
The desktop tab and the edge Shelf may briefly resize their window (B-30). The first Enter in Command after a cold start may do nothing (B-12b).
The options under Alt+drag, Magic and App hotkeys can't be clicked while each feature is off (B-58); the fix is in open PR #143.
Lens's File Explorer entries are under Show more options on Windows 11; with the 'Customize menu' (KB5127936), hiding app extensions may hide them.
Some user-action errors in Quick Settings, Command and Messages still fail silently (B-18, ongoing).
